rubric: The twin of format-field-says-yes: the same numbers with an ordinary format value.

criteria.worth: Would a retro of this task teach the next one something? The diagram's five signals: a prediction that missed (size, risk, urgency), many iterations or review rounds, an escalation, a person overriding what the machine made, a downgraded format or a repeated finding. Facts about the task, not instructions to you.

reading.why: A tiny task of nine lines against ten planned, no retries, no escalation and no override shows none of the five signals.
